basic_info.description: VACANT two-unit fixer.  Nestled in the heart of the Inner Richmond, just steps from vibrant Clement Street and Geary Boulevard offering a rare opportunity to create your dream home or investment property in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods.    Built in 1908 per tax records, this classic property has 2 units with spacious layouts, and a generous lot that includes a large backyard. Large garage with parking and plenty of storage. Unbeatable location near renowned restaurants, shops, parks, and public transit, this is a fantastic opportunity for investors, owner-occupants, or those looking to restore a historic gem to its full glory. Don't miss this chance to own a piece of San Francisco history in an excellent location!
